name: Students of Service (SOS) teen volunteer program
org: City of Santa Clara Parks & Recreation
what_you_do: Sign up once and get emails about volunteer jobs. Jobs are at city events, the teen center, the garden, theater shows and Magical Bridge Playground. You pick the ones you want and earn hours.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 13 to 18. You must live in the city of Santa Clara or go to a Santa Clara Unified school.
duration: Ongoing. You choose single shifts and events through the year.
deadline_text: Open now. The 2026 Fall sign-up runs Aug 1, 2026 to Jul 31, 2028 and still takes registrations. No closing date.
how_to_apply: Sign up free on the city's sign-up page. The city then emails you open jobs. Kindness Ambassador shifts at the playground need a short training first (about 40 minutes, in person or on Zoom). Call 408-615-3760 or email ytc@santaclaraca.gov.
notes: Registration is free. The training for Kindness Ambassador shifts counts toward your hours. The same page lists a Summer Junior Leader program (ages 14-18) for camps and swim programs, but it charges a fee and summer 2026 is closed.
